question: Six persons A, B, C, K, L and M are sitting on a table facing each other. Three of them are facing the north and the rest are facing the south. A is not opposite to L who is at any of the extreme end positions. K is at one of the middle positions and at immediate right to M. C is at one of the extreme end positions. A is not opposite to K. C and L are on the same side. Who is adjacent to B on the right side?
solution:

2) A is not opposite to L who is at any of the extreme end positions.
